sections.text: Introduction

This document outlines the testing procedure P1, 
which must be performed on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the above 
title block .

The type IFC relays are single - phase time over 
current relays with long - time characteristics - this relay types include an 
induction disk time over current unit.

The type IFC 57AD over 
current manufactured by G.E this procedure details steps required to 
completely check the proper operation and calibration the IFC 57AD relay .

The first draft initiated by eng. Fayza El-Sharkawy, 
tested by eng. Shirin Hamdy & Eng. Azza Salama, revised by Quality Control eng. 
Adel El-Nagar at EDEP Co., accepted by eng. Fawzy El-Zematy General Director, approved by 
eng. Awad Sleman Head Sector of Talkha Power Station, and certified by eng. Aly 
Mostafa Al Lethy; EDEPCo. inspection & quality control Head Sector.
Safety Precautions

A work permit
must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable
safety category,
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

Use safety and 
healthy equipment as safety helmet and safety shoes ... etc
Line isolation is required.

Make sure CT secondary circuits are shorted before isolating the relay current 
circuit for current injection

sections.text: Testing the Relay

items:
Connect 
 test leads between the current terminals number (5 and 6) on the relay to 
 the current terminals on the test set as shown in fig. (1).

Slowly increase the current until the contacts 
 close the relay must operate with a current between +10% of the 
 setting value.
Record this value on the test sheet.

Increase the injected current with a value 25% 
 greater than the operating value.

Slowly decrease the current until the relay 
 resets.
Record this value on the test sheet.

sections.text:
Time 
Test

Connect the time delayed contacts numbers ( 1 
and 2 ) on the relay to timer terminals on the test set .

Start the test by injecting current into the 
relay. the timer will stop once the relay has picked up .
Record this value of time on the test sheet .
Repeat the above test steps for other phases .
